'''Writ Tsall''' was a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] who has found his way to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Glova]] after a variety of misadventures. Capable with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], he used to demand 500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for his services, upping it to 1,000 credits or 500 and off-planet passage once he figured out that the mission might be dangerous.
